GMB.note: No public procurement system is mentioned.

facts.fact: The Gamswitch release says the Central Bank of The Gambia provided regulatory leadership and oversight for BANTABA 2.0, the national switch that went live after a pilot and is operated by Gamswitch.

GMB.note: The deputy governor's remark on consumer protection names no rule or complaints body.
Only future regional integration is mentioned, with no corridor or regional system in service.
Salary and social transfer payments are described as something the switch can support, with no programme named.

facts.fact: The release says BANTABA 2.0 allows instant transfers between bank accounts and mobile wallets, and funds to move between accounts regardless of provider.

The release says BANTABA 2.0 connects banks, mobile money operators, microfinance institutions, fintechs and PSPs through a single interoperable switch, live after a pilot, with further institutions to join.

GMB.note: Tax collection is named only as something the switch can support, with no tax or fee paid through it.
